scenes.title: Lightning
scenes.text: Lightning strikes Earth roughly eight million times a day, lighting the planet again and again.

scenes.title: Record Heat
scenes.text: The hottest temperature ever recorded on Earth reached fifty six degrees Celsius in the shade.

scenes.title: Deep Freeze
scenes.text: The coldest place on Earth drops below minus eighty nine degrees, cold enough to freeze breath.

scenes.title: Wettest
scenes.text: Some places get nearly twelve meters of rain a year, enough to drown a house in weeks.

scenes.title: Fastest
scenes.text: The fastest winds on Earth can race faster than a racing car, reshaping everything in their path.

scenes.title: Unique
scenes.text: No two snowflakes are alike because each one grows through its own tiny path of temperature and chance.

scenes.title: Why Blue
scenes.text: The sky is blue because air scatters blue light more than other colors, painting our daytime world.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: Weather shapes every single day of your life. What is the wildest weather you have ever seen?
